items.title: NanoProof: Open and Efficient Automated Theorem Proving in Lean 4
items.abstract_or_text: We introduce NanoProof, to our knowledge the first factorized execution-guided theorem prover in Lean 4 whose training data, extraction tooling, training pipeline, and weights are all released, making it end-to-end reproducible using open-source resources. To this end, we build and release a dataset of structured proof trees, as well as a tool for programmatic interaction and data extraction within the Lean 4 formal verifier. To support sustainable research, we focus on compute efficiency to facilitate accessible training and evaluation. NanoProof achieves 50.8% pass@16 on MiniF2F-Test, exceeding the two closest systems of its class, HyperTree Proof Search and ABEL, at roughly 90x and 7x less compute, and using more than four orders of magnitude less compute than AlphaProof. Stronger open-weight provers exist, but they are fine-tuned from large pretrained language models and release neither training data nor pipeline; NanoProof shows that the factorized execution-guided class of provers can be rebuilt from scratch with modest resources.
items.summary_zh: 发布端到端可复现的 Lean 4 自动定理证明器 NanoProof，包括训练数据、提取工具、训练流程和权重；在 MiniF2F-Test 上达到 50.8% pass@16。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 强调开放数据与低算力复现，并用 Lean 内核和标准基准给出可检验的证明成功率。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出 NanoProof，据我们所知，这是第一个因子化的、执行引导的 Lean 4 定理证明器，其训练数据、提取工具、训练流程和权重全部公开，因此可以使用开源资源端到端复现。为此，我们构建并发布结构化证明树数据集，以及一个用于在 Lean 4 形式验证器中进行程序化交互和数据提取的工具。为支持可持续研究，我们关注计算效率，以便开展可负担的训练和评估。NanoProof 在 MiniF2F-Test 上达到 50.8% 的 pass@16，在同类系统中超过最近的两个系统 HyperTree Proof Search 和 ABEL，同时所用计算量约分别少 90 倍和 7 倍；与 AlphaProof 相比，所用计算量少四个数量级以上。更强的开放权重证明器确实存在，但它们从大型预训练语言模型微调而来，既不发布训练数据，也不发布流程；NanoProof 表明，因子化执行引导类证明器可以用适度资源从头重建。

items.abstract_or_text: Working with AI models, I've arrived at what I consider the most significant pure-theory breakthrough of my research (in theoretical neuroscience) so far: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12426 In 1988, Sompolinsky, Crisanti, and Sommers introduced a nonlinear recurrent-network model of N randomly coupled neurons that becomes chaotic when the coupling strength exceeds a critical value. In the same paper, the authors obtained the largest Lyapunov exponent from the ground-state energy of a Schrödinger equation and named the full Lyapunov spectrum as an open problem. Four decades after the problem was posed, this paper derives the full Lyapunov spectrum at large N from a simple self-consistent single-site problem. After working independently for 100 minutes with Max thinking, GPT-6 Astra produced the initial derivation, yielding a self-consistent problem whose solution matched simulations of large networks.
items.summary_zh: 理论神经科学研究者 David Clark 称，在 GPT-6 Astra 协助下，他独立工作约 100 分钟得到大规模随机递归网络完整 Lyapunov 谱的初步推导，并与大网络模拟吻合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是研究者对预印本和 AI 协作过程的个人陈述，帖文未提供完整推导细节；其价值在于给出可检验的数学对象、模拟对照和协作时长，而不是证明模型已独立完成研究。
items.abstract_zh: 在使用 AI 模型的过程中，我得出了迄今为止我认为自己研究中最重要的纯理论突破（理论神经科学领域）：https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12426。1988 年，Sompolinsky、Crisanti 和 Sommers 提出了一个由 N 个随机耦合神经元组成的非线性递归网络模型；当耦合强度超过临界值时，该模型会变得混沌。在同一篇论文中，作者从薛定谔方程的基态能量得到最大 Lyapunov 指数，并将完整 Lyapunov 谱列为开放问题。这个问题提出四十年后，本文从一个简单的自洽单点问题出发，在大 N 极限下推导出完整 Lyapunov 谱。在使用 Max thinking 独立工作 100 分钟后，GPT-6 Astra 给出了初始推导，得到的自洽问题的解与大规模网络模拟相符。

items.title: Designing organic photoredox catalysts as a fragment-based puzzle solved by reinforcement learning
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising strategy for identifying optimal solutions in vast search spaces. We have developed a framework in which the design of organic photoredox catalysts (OPCs) is deliberately formulated as a fragment-based puzzle that is well suited to RL. In this framework, an RL agent sequentially selects and orders molecular fragments and attempts to identify fragment combinations that afford high rewards, as calculated based on the similarity between the properties of the generated molecules and those of 4CzIPN, a well-known OPC. In addition to the rediscovery of a previously reported high-performance OPC, experimental validation of the proposed candidates revealed a TADF emitter with redox potentials similar to those of 4CzIPN, as well as an OPC with superior catalytic activity in several photoreactions.
items.summary_zh: 将有机光氧化还原催化剂设计形式化为片段拼图，由强化学习代理按序选择片段，以 4CzIPN 的性质相似度作为奖励，并通过实验发现具有相近氧化还原电位的 TADF 发光体和催化活性更高的 OPC。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把分子片段组装和目标性质优化结合起来，并完成了候选物实验验证，说明强化学习可用于有机光催化剂的可合成探索。奖励函数围绕 4CzIPN 相似性设计，可能限制发现与参考物性质差异较大的催化剂。
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习（RL）是从巨大搜索空间中寻找最优解的有前景策略。我们开发了一个框架，将有机光氧化还原催化剂（OPC）的设计有意表述为适合 RL 的片段拼图。在该框架中，RL 代理依次选择并排列分子片段，并尝试找出能获得高奖励的片段组合；奖励根据生成分子的性质与 4CzIPN（一种众所周知的 OPC）的性质之间的相似度计算。除了重新发现此前报道的高性能 OPC 外，对所提候选物的实验验证还发现了一种与 4CzIPN 具有相似氧化还原电位的 TADF 发光体，以及一种在数种光反应中具有更高催化活性的 OPC。

items.title: Cross-species representation learning aligns mouse and human neural dynamics and tracks clinical drug efficacy
items.abstract_or_text: Preclinical models poorly predict human drug efficacy, particularly in neurological disorders. Neural activity offers a uniquely rich source of translational information because it captures high-dimensional variation in nervous-system function that can be measured in both animals and humans. However, its high dimensionality makes it difficult to distinguish conserved disease-related features from variation arising from species, recording modality and experimental context. Here, we test whether shared neural dynamics can be identified directly from electrophysiology data by learning representations organized by biological state rather than species. We develop a dual-rule contrastive learning framework that aligns corresponding mouse and human states while preserving separation between distinct phenotypes. This framework recovered conserved sensory-response structure across species and, in epilepsy, resolved distinct relationships between three mouse models and heterogeneous human patient populations. When treated animals were projected into a frozen cross-species representation, drug-induced movement towards the human-aligned healthy state retrospectively tracked known clinical efficacy across ten model-drug combinations including a disease-specific detrimental effect. The framework also identified shared disease-associated neural dynamics between Fmr1-knockout mice and human 16p11.2 copy-number variant carriers despite differences in genetic aetiology and recording modality. Together, these findings show the potential of cross-species neural representation learning to map heterogeneous human disease onto experimentally tractable preclinical states and assess whether interventions restore human-relevant circuit function.
items.summary_zh: 预印本用双规则对比学习对齐小鼠与人类神经动力学，在癫痫和 Fmr1/16p11.2 模型中比较跨物种疾病状态，并回溯评估10种模型—药物组合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它提供了把动物神经活动映射到人类疾病状态的转化建模路径；但药物效能关联是回溯性追踪，不是前瞻性临床疗效或因果验证。
items.abstract_zh: 临床前模型对人类药物疗效的预测能力较弱，尤其是在神经系统疾病中。神经活动提供了独特且丰富的转化信息来源，因为它捕捉了可在人类和动物中测量的神经系统功能高维变化。然而，其高维性使得区分保守的疾病相关特征与由物种、记录模态和实验环境造成的变异变得困难。在这里，我们通过学习按生物学状态而非物种组织的表征，检验能否直接从电生理数据中识别共享的神经动力学。我们开发了双规则对比学习框架，对齐对应的小鼠和人类状态，同时保持不同表型之间的分离。该框架恢复了跨物种保守的感觉反应结构；在癫痫研究中，它解析了三个小鼠模型与异质性人类患者群体之间的不同关系。当将接受治疗的动物投影到冻结的跨物种表征中时，药物诱导的向与人类对齐的健康状态移动，在10种模型—药物组合中回溯性追踪了已知的临床疗效，其中包括一种疾病特异性的有害效应。该框架还识别出 Fmr1 敲除小鼠与人类 16p11.2 拷贝数变异携带者之间共享的疾病相关神经动力学，尽管二者的遗传病因和记录模态不同。总体而言，这些结果显示，跨物种神经表征学习有潜力将异质性人类疾病映射到可进行实验操作的临床前状态，并评估干预是否恢复了与人类相关的回路功能。

items.title: @alex_verem：Did Google just automate the PhD? Google researchers built an AI that reads a problem, forms hypotheses, runs experiment
items.abstract_or_text: Did Google just automate the PhD? Google researchers built an AI that reads a problem, forms hypotheses, runs experiments, writes the paper, and simulates its own peer review. No human steps in once the problem is set. It's called ScientistTwo. They gave it 107 problems from papers accepted at ICLR, ICML, and NeurIPS, and it beat the published human result on 86 of them. The average gain over the human method was 25.2%. The average paper took about 2.5 days and cost about 3,765 in model and compute costs. Nine human reviewers compared 33 of these AI papers with accepted human papers. Their overall verdict was a tie. The same paper has the less exciting numbers too. The reviewers gave the human papers a small edge on methodological rigor. The authors say it isn't producing spotlight-level work yet. The median gain was 7.7%, so a few big wins pull the average up. Without its checking agents, 19 of its 1,840 citations were fake, and one solution broke the task rules to get a better score. With the checks on, both dropped to zero. A researcher still has to pick the right question. The AI cuts the wait for the answer to a few days. Would you trust a paper if you knew an AI ran every experiment in it? Paper's in the first reply 👇
items.summary_zh: 作者转述 Google 研究者的 ScientistTwo：系统可自主提出假设、运行实验、写论文并模拟同行评审；在107个已发表问题中有86个超过原有人类结果，但方法严谨性略逊，且检查代理对虚假引用和违规解题很关键。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是研究结果的公开转述，帖文未给出论文链接正文或独立核验；它同时呈现平均收益、长尾效应、成本和审稿评价，适合用于讨论 AI 科研系统的可复现性与评测边界。
items.abstract_zh: Google 真的自动化了博士学位吗？Google 研究者构建了一种 AI：读取问题、提出假设、运行实验、撰写论文，并模拟自己的同行评审。问题设定后不再需要人类介入。他们用来自 ICLR、ICML 和 NeurIPS 接收论文的 107 个问题进行测试，其中 86 个超过了已发表的人类结果；相对于人类方法，平均提升 25.2%。每篇论文平均耗时约 2.5 天，模型和计算成本约 3765。9 名人类评审比较了其中 33 篇 AI 论文与已接收的人类论文，总体判断是平局。论文中不那么亮眼的数字是：在人类论文的方法严谨性方面，评审给了小幅优势。作者说，它还没有产出能登上聚光灯的成果。中位数提升为 7.7%，因此平均值受到少数大幅胜出的结果拉动。没有检查代理时，1840 条引用中有 19 条是虚假的，并且有一个解法为获得更高分而违反了任务规则；启用检查后，两项都降为零。研究者仍需选择正确的问题，而 AI 把得到答案的等待时间压缩到几天。

items.abstract_or_text: Today we are announcing Harvey LAB-AA v1.1 in collaboration with Harvey. This updates our scoring methodology for the Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB) to add a hallucination check and require correct responses to not include material misstatements. LAB-AA v1.1's new headline metric, Hallucination-Gated All-Pass Rate, only credits a task when the deliverables satisfy every rubric criterion and contain no material hallucinations. Grok 4.7 (xhigh) leads at 9.4% Hallucination-Gated All-Pass Rate, and >60% of otherwise passing results across the models tested at launch contain a material hallucination. ➤ Top of the leaderboard: Grok 4.7 (xhigh) from @SpaceXAI leads at 9.4%, narrowly ahead of Muse Spark 1.3 (max) from @AIatMeta at 8.9% and GPT-6 Astra (max) from @OpenAI at 8.6% ➤ The GPT-6 model family is the most grounded: GPT-6 Astra (max) averages 0.03 material hallucinations per task.

items.title: A transient third metal ion shapes the catalytic cycle of a group I intron ribozyme
items.abstract_or_text: The self-splicing group I intron ribozyme from Tetrahymena thermophillia (THr) is a prototypical example of how RNA overcomes its limited chemical repertoire to form complex, negatively charged junctions and catalyze chemical reactions. Despite over 30 years of biochemical and structural characterization, questions still remain regarding the requirements for THr catalysis that may inform structure based drug design against group I introns, as well as the use of THr as an RNA editing tool. Recent cryo-EM structures have provided an unprecedented window into the first and second steps of splicing, enabling detailed mechanistic investigation at the atomistic level. In this work, we leverage solvation theory, molecular dynamics, alchemical free energy simulations, and machine learning accelerated QM/MM to probe outstanding questions related to 1) the role of a possible third Mg2+ binding in the active site, 2) differences in catalytic requirements between Gexo cofactors and between the first and second steps of splicing, 3) the potential role of an acid or base, and 4) restrictions on the identity of the 5' exon splice site nucleotide, U(-1). We propose that a transient, cofactor dependent, interaction with a third metal participates in the first step, while a higher affinity interaction with this third ion is required in the second step. We also propose that the presence of a phosphate on the Gexo in the first step, and analogously the G{omega} in the second step, forms a metal ion binding site not present when guanosine is bound. Finally, we propose and computationally test design modifications of G22 (isofunctional substitutions of 2,6-diaminopurine that tune the pKa at the N1 position) that we predict will enable the accommodation of C(-1) in a crucial wobble-like pair at physiological pH. This design would provide a potential strategy for expanding the sequence space accessible to programmable trans-splicing ribozymes in RNA editing applications.
items.summary_zh: 结合溶剂化理论、分子动力学、炼金术自由能模拟和机器学习加速 QM/MM，研究 Tetrahymena group I intron 核酶催化中瞬态第三个 Mg2+ 的作用，并提出可扩展 RNA 编辑底物范围的 G22 改造。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为 RNA 核酶两步剪接的金属协同机制提供原子级假说，并将计算机制研究连接到可测试的 RNA 编辑设计。摘要未报告直接实验验证，提出的结合和 pKa 预测仍需实验确认。
items.abstract_zh: Tetrahymena thermophillia（THr）的自剪接 group I intron 核酶是 RNA 如何克服有限化学组成、形成复杂带负电连接并催化化学反应的典型例子。尽管经过 30 多年的生化和结构表征，关于 THr 催化要求的问题仍然存在；这些问题不仅可能为针对 group I intron 的结构基础药物设计提供信息，也关系到将 THr 用作 RNA 编辑工具。近期的 cryo-EM 结构为剪接的第一步和第二步提供了前所未有的观察窗口，使得在原子尺度研究其机制成为可能。在本研究中，我们利用溶剂化理论、分子动力学、炼金术自由能模拟和机器学习加速的 QM/MM，探讨以下尚未解决的问题：1）可能存在的第三个 Mg2+ 与活性位点的结合；2）Gexo 辅因子之间以及剪接第一步和第二步之间催化要求的差异；3）酸或碱的潜在作用；4）5' exon splice site nucleotide U(-1) 身份的限制。我们提出，在第一步中，瞬态的、依赖辅因子的第三个金属相互作用参与催化，而在第二步中则需要该第三个离子具有更高亲和力的相互作用。我们还提出，在第一步中 Gexo 上的 phosphate，以及第二步中相应的 Gω，会形成一个在 guanosine 结合时不存在的金属离子结合位点。最后，我们提出并通过计算测试了 G22 的设计改造，即对 2,6-diaminopurine 进行可调节 N1 位点 pKa 的同功能替换；我们预测该改造能够在生理 pH 下容纳 C(-1)，形成关键的类 wobble 配对。这一设计将为扩大可编程反式剪接核酶在 RNA 编辑应用中可访问的序列空间提供潜在策略。
items.author_line: McCarthy, E., Ekesan, S., Giese, T. J., Du, Y., Barletta, G. P., Götz, A. W., Piccirilli, J. A., York, D. M.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence Applied to Epigenomic Data in Leukemia: A Systematic Review of Diagnostic, Prognostic and Monitoring Models
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Epigenetic deregulation is a defining feature of leukemia, and DNA methylation and chromatin accessibility profiles encode the cell of origin, lineage and clinical behaviour of the disease. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) can extract predictive patterns from these high-dimensional data, but the published models have not been systematically appraised. We systematically reviewed AI models built on epigenomic data in leukemia for diagnosis, prognosis, relapse and treatment-response prediction, and measurable residual disease (MRD) detection. Methods: This review followed PRISMA 2020 and the SWiM guideline. PubMed was searched on 7 October 2026 with three structured queries, supplemented by a broader PubMed query, citation searching and web searching. Eligible studies were peer-reviewed primary studies that applied an ML or deep-learning algorithm to DNA methylation, chromatin-accessibility or histone-modification data from human leukemia samples and reported a quantitative diagnostic, prognostic, response or MRD outcome. Risk of bias and applicability were assessed with PROBAST, informed by PROBAST+AI. Owing to heterogeneity, results were synthesized narratively and in structured tables, without meta-analysis. Results: Of 68 unique database records and 32 reports from other sources, 30 studies (2010-2026; 22 since 2020) were included: 16 in acute myeloid leukemia, 4 in acute lymphoblastic leukemia, 2 spanning acute leukemia lineages, 3 in juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia and 5 in chronic lymphocytic leukemia; 10 were pediatric. DNA methylation was the input in 28 studies and chromatin accessibility in 2; no eligible study modelled histone marks. Tree ensembles (n = 9) and support vector machines (n = 5) were the most frequent algorithms. Diagnostic classifiers reported accuracy, concordance or F1 scores of 0.87-1.00, and two classifiers were applied to nanopore sequencing data, one returning acute leukemia subtype calls within about 2 hours. Prognostic epigenomic scores were associated with survival (reported hazard ratios 2.36-10.82), but discrimination fell on transport to independent cohorts (C-index 0.677 internally vs 0.529 in one external cohort). Fifteen studies validated models on an external epigenomic cohort, one prospectively. Overall risk of bias was high in 21 studies, unclear in 8 and low in 1, driven by the analysis domain (small samples, absent calibration, possible data leakage). Calibration was reported in 3 studies and code was available for 11. Conclusions: Epigenomic AI models classify leukemia subtypes with high reported accuracy and can deliver same-day diagnoses, and methylation-based scores add prognostic information. However, the evidence is dominated by retrospective, high-risk-of-bias development studies with limited external validation and almost no prospective or impact evaluation. Prospective, multi-center validation with calibrated, transparently reported models is required before clinical adoption.
items.summary_zh: 预印本系统综述了白血病表观基因组 AI 模型在诊断、预后、复发、治疗反应和微小残留病灶检测中的证据，纳入30项研究并系统评估偏倚。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它集中揭示了表观基因组模型从高报告准确率到临床可迁移性之间的落差：多数研究偏倚风险高，外部验证、校准和前瞻性影响评估不足，因此不能把关联性预后信号视为临床因果或可用性证据。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：表观遗传失调是白血病的定义性特征，DNA 甲基化和染色质可及性谱编码了细胞起源、谱系和疾病临床行为的信息。人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）可以从这些高维数据中提取预测模式，但既有模型尚未得到系统评价。我们系统综述了基于白血病表观基因组数据构建的 AI 模型，这些模型用于诊断、预后、复发和治疗反应预测，以及可测量残留病灶（MRD）检测。方法：本综述遵循 PRISMA 2020 和 SWiM 指南。PubMed 检索于 2026 年 10 月 7 日进行，采用三条结构化检索式，并补充更宽泛的 PubMed 检索式、引文追踪和网络检索。纳入标准为：在人类白血病样本的 DNA 甲基化、染色质可及性或组蛋白修饰数据上应用 ML 或深度学习算法，并报告定量诊断、预后、反应或 MRD 结局的同行评议原始研究。偏倚风险和适用性依据 PROBAST、并参考 PROBAST+AI 进行评估。由于研究异质性，结果采用叙述性综述和结构化表格综合，未进行荟萃分析。结果：在68条独特数据库记录和其他来源的32份报告中，共纳入30项研究（2010—2026 年；其中22项发表于 2020 年以后）：急性髓系白血病16项、急性淋巴细胞白血病4项、跨急性白血病谱系2项、幼年型粒单核细胞白血病3项、慢性淋巴细胞白血病5项；其中10项为儿科研究。28项研究以 DNA 甲基化为输入，2项以染色质可及性为输入，没有符合条件的研究对组蛋白标记建模。树集成模型（n = 9）和支持向量机（n = 5）是最常用算法。诊断分类器报告的准确率、一致性或 F1 分数为 0.87—1.00；其中两个分类器应用于纳米孔测序数据，一个可在约2小时内给出急性白血病亚型判定。表观基因组预后评分与生存相关（报告的风险比为 2.36—10.82），但迁移至独立队列后区分度下降（一个外部队列中，内部 C-index 为 0.677，外部为 0.529）。15项研究在外部表观基因组队列上验证模型，其中1项为前瞻性验证。总体偏倚风险在21项研究中较高，8项不明确，仅1项较低；主要问题来自分析领域，包括样本量小、缺少校准和可能的数据泄漏。仅3项研究报告了校准，11项提供了代码。结论：表观基因组 AI 模型可以以较高报告准确率对白血病亚型进行分类，并可能实现当日诊断；基于甲基化的评分也可增加预后信息。然而，现有证据主要来自回顾性、高偏倚风险的模型开发研究，外部验证有限，几乎没有前瞻性或临床影响评估。在临床采用前，需要开展前瞻性、多中心验证，并使用经过校准且透明报告的模型。
items.author_line: Martelli, J., Martelli, J.

items.title: Sex-aware Cross-tissue Regulatory Transformer Identified Sexually Dimorphic Alzheimer's Disease Risk Loci and Causal Cellular Circuit
items.abstract_or_text: Sex differences in Alzheimer's disease (AD) genetic effects and regulatory contexts remain incompletely resolved. We analyzed 449,335 European-ancestry participants using sex-stratified and genotype-by-sex models and developed STAGE-AD, a Transformer integrating molecular QTLs, epigenomic and single-cell annotations. Sex-stratified analyses identified eight female and three male genome-wide-significant signals provisionally classified as novel. Primary test-set area under the precision-recall curve was 0.895 (95% confidence interval, 0.877-0.912), decreasing to 0.751 under locus hold-out and 0.681 under APOE-region hold-out. Statistical-genetic integration in independent HUNT and MVP cohorts supported 236 genes at 106 loci. Prespecified lifetime-risk assumptions yielded liability-scale SNP heritabilities of 11.42% in females and 9.23% in males. Ablations indicated that female-biased predictions depended on glial annotations and male-biased predictions on endothelial and oligodendrocyte annotations. Eleven candidate variant-gene-tissue-cell-pathology chains were evaluated using multi-omics and neuropathological data from 579 NPAD brain donors. These findings underscore the importance of considering sex-specific genetic architectures in the study of health conditions, including Alzheimer's disease, paving the way for more targeted treatment strategies.
items.summary_zh: 预印本在449,335名欧洲血统参与者中开展性别分层遗传分析，训练整合分子 QTL、表观基因组和单细胞注释的 STAGE-AD Transformer，并在579名脑供体上检验候选变异—基因—组织—细胞—病理链。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究把性别特异遗传结构与细胞类型注释结合起来，但 locus hold-out 和 APOE-region hold-out 性能下降，候选链仍是统计遗传与多组学支持，不应直接表述为已证实的因果回路。
items.abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）遗传效应和调控环境中的性别差异仍未得到充分解析。我们分析了449,335名欧洲血统参与者，采用按性别分层的分析和基因型—性别交互模型，并开发了 STAGE-AD：一种整合分子 QTL、表观基因组和单细胞注释的 Transformer。按性别分层的分析识别出8个女性和3个男性的全基因组显著信号，并暂时将其归类为新信号。主要测试集的精确率—召回率曲线下面积为0.895（95%置信区间，0.877—0.912）；在基因座留出设置下下降至0.751，在 APOE 区域留出设置下下降至0.681。独立 HUNT 和 MVP 队列中的统计遗传整合支持106个基因座上的236个基因。预先规定的终生风险假设得到责任尺度 SNP 遗传力：女性为11.42%，男性为9.23%。消融实验表明，女性偏向的预测依赖胶质细胞注释，而男性偏向的预测依赖内皮细胞和少突胶质细胞注释。我们利用来自579名 NPAD 脑供体的多组学和神经病理学数据，对11条候选的“变异—基因—组织—细胞—病理”链进行了评价。这些结果强调，在研究包括健康状况在内的疾病时考虑性别特异性遗传架构的重要性，并为更有针对性的治疗策略提供了可能。
items.author_line: Cheng, Z., Judaprawira, S., Perez, J., Goldstein, A.

items.title: Directed evolution of a thermostable family-A DNA polymerase into a reverse transcriptase for 2'-modified RNA
items.abstract_or_text: RNA-based therapeutics increasingly rely on nuclease-resistant xeno-nucleic acids (XNAs), but engineering polymerases capable of reading and amplifying these non-canonical substrates remains a major challenge. Natural DNA polymerases cannot process C2' sugar modifications, and the complete structural determinants governing this limitation remain poorly understood, limiting rational design strategies. In this study, we apply directed evolution methods to Thermus thermophilus DNA polymerase using a microfluidic implementation of the Compartmentalized Self-Replication (CSR). We identify an engineered variant, termed E5, capable of reverse transcribing C2'-modified RNA, a previously inaccessible activity for this enzyme. Next-generation sequencing allow us to track evolutionary trajectories across nine rounds of evolution. Through an integrated analysis combining statistical methods, protein language models, and crystallographic data, we reveal unknown epistatic networks controlling polymerase function. This large-scale experimental dataset (>196,000 thermostable enzyme variants) provides a robust basis for predicting sequence-to-function relationships, accelerating development of enzymes for aptamer discovery and synthetic biology applications.
items.summary_zh: 预印本通过微流控分区自复制对 Thermus thermophilus family-A DNA polymerase 进行9轮定向进化，筛出可逆转录 C2'-modified RNA 的 E5 变体，并积累超过196,000个酶变体数据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是有明确实验读出的蛋白质工程工作，连接定向进化、蛋白质语言模型和晶体学；E5 的应用潜力仍需在更多底物、体系和实际治疗场景中验证。
items.abstract_zh: RNA 疗法越来越依赖具有核酸酶抗性的异源核酸（XNA），但能够读取和扩增这些非经典底物的聚合酶仍难以工程化。天然 DNA 聚合酶无法处理 C2' 糖修饰，而决定这一限制的完整结构因素仍未得到充分理解，从而限制了理性设计策略。在本研究中，我们利用微流控实现的区室化自复制（CSR）对 Thermus thermophilus DNA polymerase 进行定向进化。我们鉴定出一个名为 E5 的工程化变体，能够对 C2'-modified RNA 进行逆转录，这是该酶此前无法实现的活性。随后，下一代测序追踪了9轮进化中的轨迹。通过结合统计方法、蛋白质语言模型和晶体学数据的综合分析，我们揭示了控制聚合酶功能的未知上位性网络。这个大规模实验数据集包含超过196,000个耐热酶变体，为预测序列—功能关系提供了稳健基础，并可加速适配体发现和合成生物学应用。
items.author_line: Vincent, E., Lopez, C., Sieskind, R., Commenge, I., Navaza, R., Haouz, A., Delarue, M.

items.title: Fine-tuning genomic models on rare splicing events identifies a novel biomarker of TDP-43 pathology
items.abstract_or_text: Genomic foundation models (GFMs) are pretrained on large genomic datasets, but their ability to predict rare disease-associated events after fine-tuning remains unclear. We tested this using TDP-43 cryptic exons, well characterized splicing events linked to neurodegenerative disease that are poorly represented in standard annotations. We compared the state-of-the-art GFM AlphaGenome with OpenSpliceAI, a specialized splice site prediction model. Fine-tuned OpenSpliceAI detected held-out cryptic exons in human and mouse and captured allele-specific splicing effects at the disease-associated UNC13A locus. In contrast, a splicing prediction head trained on AlphaGenome's frozen pretrained backbone failed to predict cryptic exons. Unfreezing and fine-tuning all model weights, however, enabled AlphaGenome to generalize to held-out data. To investigate cryptic splicing in cell types that are difficult to study experimentally, we applied fine-tuned OpenSpliceAI across the genome to study cell type-specific genes. This led to the identification of new cryptic splicing events in CLDN11 and ARHGAP23, which were subsequently validated in FTLD-TDP brain tissue. Notably, the cryptic exon in CLDN11 is predicted to generate a neoepitope that could serve as an oligodendrocyte-specific biomarker of TDP-43 pathology. Our results show that even a state-of-the-art GFM can fail to generalize to rare splicing events, even with substantial pretraining. However, both foundation and specialized models that learn to generalize to rare biological events can have broad applications in biological discovery and medicine.
items.summary_zh: 预印本比较 AlphaGenome 与 OpenSpliceAI 对 TDP-43 隐匿外显子和 UNC13A 等位基因特异性剪接的预测，发现全参数微调后可识别稀有事件，并在 FTLD-TDP 脑组织中验证 CLDN11 事件。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究提供了稀有剪接事件的模型泛化和组织验证证据，同时显示大规模预训练并不保证对稀有生物事件有效；CLDN11 新抗原仍是预测性生物标志物候选。
items.abstract_zh: 基因组基础模型（GFM）在大型基因组数据集上预训练，但其在微调后预测罕见疾病相关事件的能力仍不清楚。我们以 TDP-43 隐匿外显子为对象检验这一点；这些剪接事件与神经退行性疾病有关，在标准注释中代表性不足且已有较充分表征。我们比较了最先进的 GFM AlphaGenome 与专门的剪接位点预测模型 OpenSpliceAI。经过微调的 OpenSpliceAI 能够在人和小鼠中检测留出的隐匿外显子，并捕捉疾病相关 UNC13A 位点的等位基因特异性剪接效应。相比之下，在 AlphaGenome 冻结预训练骨干上训练的剪接预测头无法预测隐匿外显子。然而，解冻并微调 AlphaGenome 的全部模型权重后，它能够泛化到留出数据。为了研究难以通过实验研究的细胞类型中的隐匿剪接，我们使用微调后的 OpenSpliceAI 对全基因组进行分析。这一过程识别出 CLDN11 和 ARHGAP23 中新的细胞类型特异性隐匿剪接事件，随后在 FTLD-TDP 脑组织中得到验证。值得注意的是，CLDN11 中的隐匿外显子被预测会产生一种新抗原，可能作为 TDP-43 病理的少突胶质细胞特异性生物标志物。我们的结果表明，即使是最先进的 GFM，在大量预训练之后也可能无法对罕见剪接事件实现泛化。然而，能够学习并泛化到罕见生物事件的基础模型和专门模型，可能在生物学发现和医学中具有广泛应用。
items.author_line: Martin-Linares, C. P., Peethambaran Mallika, A., Sandal, P. S., Martin, T. W., Morris, M., Wong, P. C., Ling, J. P.

items.title: Hybrid Mechanistic-Neural Modeling of Concentration-Time Dynamics Generalizes Human Pharmacokinetics Prediction Across Unseen Chemical Space
items.abstract_or_text: The pharmacokinetics concentration-time profile encodes ADME dynamics. Its optimization in drug discovery curbs late-stage attrition, yet forecasting human pharmacokinetics from chemical structure remains difficult. Machine learning models ignore continuous ADME dynamics, whereas physiologically based pharmacokinetics (PBPK) models demand unavailable parameters and impose rigid, misspecified compartmental structures. We present PK-MUSE (PharmacoKinetic hybrid Mechanistic Universal System Equation), augmenting a two-compartment model with bounded, state- and time-dependent neural corrections to elimination and intercompartmental distribution. Molecular structure parameterizes compound-specific behavior, while learned corrections refine dynamic equations. Across scaffold and temporal out-of-distribution evaluations, PK-MUSE achieved the lowest mean exposure-endpoint MdFE, reducing MdFE by 7.2%, 45.2%, and 26.2% versus state-of-the-art machine learning (HML- RF), deep learning compartmental (DeepCt), and PBPK (PK-Sim) models. Interrogating the corrections localized misspecification to distribution rather than elimination. By extending mechanistic simulators with data-driven constrained neural dynamics that preserve interpretability and generalize to unseen chemotypes, PK-MUSE advances digital twins for drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 提出 PK-MUSE，将二室药代动力学模型与受约束的状态和时间依赖神经修正结合，用分子结构预测浓度-时间曲线，并在骨架和时间分布外测试中比较多类模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把机制模型的可解释性与神经网络的灵活性结合，直接面向 ADME 动力学和未见化学空间，具有数字孪生药物研发价值。需要注意摘要只给出模型比较指标，尚未说明更广泛的人体外部验证和参数可识别性。
items.abstract_zh: 药代动力学浓度-时间曲线编码了 ADME 动力学。优化该曲线可以减少药物发现后期的失败，但仅根据化学结构预测人体药代动力学仍然困难。机器学习模型忽略连续的 ADME 动力学，而生理学基础药代动力学（PBPK）模型需要无法获得的参数，并施加刚性且可能设定错误的区室结构。我们提出 PK-MUSE（PharmacoKinetic hybrid Mechanistic Universal System Equation），在二室模型中加入有界的、状态和时间依赖的神经修正，以修正消除和区室间分布。分子结构用于参数化化合物特异性行为，学习到的修正项则细化动力学方程。在骨架和时间分布外评估中，PK-MUSE 获得了最低的平均暴露终点 MdFE；与先进机器学习模型（HML- RF）、深度学习区室模型（DeepCt）和 PBPK 模型（PK-Sim）相比，MdFE 分别降低了 7.2%、45.2% 和 26.2%。对修正项的解析将模型设定错误定位到分布过程而非消除过程。通过用数据驱动且受约束的神经动力学扩展机制模拟器，同时保持可解释性并泛化到未见化学类型，PK-MUSE 推进了面向药物发现的数字孪生。
items.author_line: Badkul, A., Cai, L., Kim, M., Wang, J., Xie, L.

items.title: Zatom-2: Multitask Pretraining on Atomistic Data for Generative Modeling across Domains
items.abstract_or_text: Unified atomistic modeling has the potential to accelerate discovery in chemistry, materials science, and biology by bridging data-rich chemical domains and data-scarce biological contexts. However, existing generative approaches to atomistic modeling remain highly specialized to scientific disciplines (chemistry vs. biology) or do not leverage both high-volume organic (molecule) and inorganic (material) data for general-purpose pretraining. To this end, we introduce Zatom-2, an atomistic generative model pretrained on approximately five million structures from the OMol25 and OMat24 electronic structure datasets. Zatom-2 features a multiscale Transformer architecture coupled with conditional flow matching that supports force conditioning and foundational pretraining tasks such as generation, structure prediction, and prediction of molecular and material energies and forces. Empirically, Zatom-2 achieves better molecular distribution fidelity than Zatom-1 and achieves strong performance on existing molecule and material generation benchmarks. Zatom-2 demonstrates the ability to control sample generation across low- and high-force regimes, and enhances protein generation in a low-data setting through joint generative-predictive pretraining and transfer learning, increasing protein backbone designability in a length extrapolation setting from 67.8% without pretraining to 74.8% after finetuning on 2,000 protein domains.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Zatom-2，在约五百万个有机分子和无机材料结构上进行多任务预训练，并用多尺度 Transformer 与 conditional flow matching 统一支持生成、结构预测及能量和力预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 尝试跨分子、材料和蛋白质领域共享原子级表示，展示了低数据蛋白设计中的迁移收益。摘要主要报告基准和迁移结果，训练数据分布与不同领域间的性能权衡仍需细查。
items.abstract_zh: 统一的原子级建模有望通过连接数据丰富的化学领域和数据稀缺的生物学环境，加速化学、材料科学和生物学中的发现。然而，现有原子级生成方法仍高度专门化于不同科学学科（化学与生物学），或者没有同时利用高容量有机数据（分子）和无机数据（材料）进行通用预训练。为此，我们提出 Zatom-2，这是一种在 OMol25 和 OMat24 电子结构数据集的约五百万个结构上预训练的原子级生成模型。Zatom-2 采用多尺度 Transformer 架构与 conditional flow matching 相结合，支持力条件控制以及生成、结构预测和分子与材料能量及力预测等基础预训练任务。实验证明，Zatom-2 的分子分布保真度优于 Zatom-1，并在现有分子和材料生成基准上取得了较强表现。Zatom-2 能够控制低力和高力区域的样本生成，并通过联合生成-预测预训练和迁移学习，在低数据条件下增强蛋白质生成：在长度外推设置中，在 2,000 个蛋白质结构域上微调后，蛋白质骨架的可设计性从未预训练时的 67.8% 提升到 74.8%。
items.author_line: Miruna Cretu, Alex Abrudan, Antonia Panescu, Tynan Perez, Rishabh Anand, N. Benjamin Erichson, Michael W. Mahoney, Samuel Blau, Joseph Jacobson, Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli, Rex Ying, Tuomas Knowles, Pietro Liò, Alex Morehead

items.title: RAGenome: Scaling Retrieval-Based Genomic Language Models to Long Contexts
items.abstract_or_text: The genome holds the blueprint that governs the biological properties of the cell. Consequently, advancing our knowledge of genomic function is crucial both for a broader understanding of biology and for continued biomedical advances. The success of large language models on natural language and protein sequences has motivated similar efforts on genomic data. However, standard genomic language models (gLMs) often require extremely large computational resources and still fall behind traditional methods on some downstream tasks. Recently, MSA-based pretraining has been proposed as an efficient alternative, but existing models are limited to short input contexts, restricting their use to short-range tasks, such as variant effect prediction. In this work, we present RAGenome, the first retrieval-based gLM that scales pretraining to longer contexts (100\times longer than existing MSA-based gLMs), allowing it to capture both across-species evolutionary relationships and within-species longer-range interactions. Trained on whole-genome alignments from 100 vertebrates, RAGenome substantially improves the long-range capabilities of MSA-based gLMs, raising gene finding performance from 0.45 to 0.60, while remaining competitive on purely evolutionary-based tasks like prioritizing pathogenic variants. RAGenome provides competitive gLM performance at a fraction of the training cost, unifying evolutionary modeling and long-range capabilities within a single, flexible, scalable framework. Code is available at https://github.com/PanosAntoniadis/RAGenome.
items.summary_zh: 预印本提出 RAGenome，在100种脊椎动物全基因组比对上训练检索式基因组语言模型，将 MSA 上下文扩展到现有模型的100倍，并提升基因寻找性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把跨物种进化关系与物种内长程基因组相互作用放进同一模型，并报告代码公开；但基因寻找从0.45到0.60的提升仍是模型基准结果。
items.abstract_zh: 基因组承载着支配细胞生物学性质的蓝图。因此，推进我们对基因组功能的认识，对于更广泛地理解生物学和持续推进生物医学都至关重要。大型语言模型在自然语言和蛋白质序列上的成功，推动了对基因组数据开展类似工作。然而，标准基因组语言模型（gLM）通常需要极其庞大的计算资源，并且在某些下游任务上仍落后于传统方法。近期，基于 MSA 的预训练被提出作为一种高效替代方案，但现有模型局限于较短输入上下文，限制了其在短程任务（例如变异效应预测）中的应用。在这项工作中，我们提出 RAGenome，这是首个将预训练扩展到更长上下文的检索式 gLM，其上下文长度达到现有基于 MSA 的 gLM 的100倍，使模型能够捕捉跨物种进化关系以及物种内更长程的相互作用。RAGenome 在100种脊椎动物的全基因组比对上训练，显著增强了基于 MSA 的 gLM 的长程能力，使基因寻找性能从0.45提高到0.60，同时在致病变异优先级排序等纯进化任务上保持竞争力。RAGenome 以训练成本的一小部分提供具有竞争力的 gLM 性能，在单一灵活且可扩展的框架中统一了进化建模和长程能力。代码已在 https://github.com/PanosAntoniadis/RAGenome 公开。
items.author_line: Frederikke Isa Marin, Panagiotis Antoniadis, Dionysia Danai Brilli, Andreas Bjerregaard, Rachael DeVries, Yan Li, Ole Winther, Wouter Boomsma

items.title: SpatialOmicsLab: an integrated research environment for AI co-scientists in spatial transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial profiling is moving from method development into a central platform for biological discovery and clinical translation, but analyzing such complex data has become the bottleneck of scientific discovery. Translating spatial transcriptomic measurements into biological insight requires reproducible workflows that integrate diverse analytical methods. Although language-model agents can plan and execute multistep analyses, fragmented data and software ecosystems hinder their use as reliable research assistants. In this study, we introduce SpatialOmicsLab, an integrated research environment for spatial transcriptomics comprising 113 curated computational tools, 63 reference datasets and 4,614 task specifications. We also introduce ST-Coscientist, an AI co-scientist that uses this environment to assemble, execute and refine spatial transcriptomic analyses. Within SpatialOmicsLab, ST-Coscientist outperformed expert-led workflows and other scientific agents across six benchmark settings spanning spatial clustering, cell-type deconvolution and spatially variable gene detection. It constructed alignment-aware workflows for three-dimensional MERFISH data and addressed biological questions by selecting and analysing relevant reference datasets. Procedural memory increased the success rate of integrating and validating additional analytical tools from 48% to 95%. Together, SpatialOmicsLab and ST-Coscientist establish an extensible ecosystem for reproducible spatial transcriptomic research, enabling AI co-scientists to address evolving biological questions with an expanding analytical repertoire.
items.summary_zh: 预印本构建 SpatialOmicsLab，整合113个计算工具、63个参考数据集和4,614项任务规格，并用 ST-Coscientist 自动组装和执行空间转录组分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将研究代理放入可复现工具和数据环境，并报告六类基准、三维 MERFISH 工作流和工具验证成功率提升；但“优于专家工作流”的结论仍依赖摘要所述基准设置。
items.abstract_zh: 空间分析正从方法开发阶段进入生物学发现和临床转化的核心平台阶段，但分析这些复杂数据已经成为科学发现的瓶颈。将空间转录组测量转化为生物学洞见，需要整合多种分析方法的可复现工作流。虽然语言模型代理可以规划并执行多步骤分析，但碎片化的数据和软件生态阻碍了它们成为可靠的研究助手。在本研究中，我们介绍 SpatialOmicsLab：一个用于空间转录组学的综合研究环境，其中包含113个经过整理的计算工具、63个参考数据集和4,614项任务规格。我们还介绍 ST-Coscientist，这是一种 AI 科学家，它利用该环境组装、执行和改进空间转录组分析。在 SpatialOmicsLab 中，ST-Coscientist 在六种基准设置下超过专家主导的工作流和其他科学代理，这些设置涵盖空间聚类、细胞类型去卷积和空间变异基因检测。它为三维 MERFISH 数据构建了考虑对齐的工作流，并通过选择和分析相关参考数据集来回答生物学问题。程序记忆使整合并验证额外分析工具的成功率从48%提高到95%。总体而言，SpatialOmicsLab 和 ST-Coscientist 建立了一个可扩展的空间转录组可复现研究生态，使 AI 科学家能够借助不断扩展的分析工具集处理不断变化的生物学问题。
items.author_line: Jiang, Y., Zhan, X., Quan, P., Wang, R., Wu, F., Mi, J., Yao, J., Yao, B., Xiao, G., Shi, W., Xie, Y.

items.title: Natural Language to First-Order Logic LLM-based Autoformalization
items.abstract_or_text: Large Language Models (LLMs) have renewed interest in autoformalization. Yet, when First-Order Logic (FOL) is considered as the target formalism, the field still lacks a unified task formulation and a systematic survey. This paper addresses this gap: we first provide a principled definition for the FOL-autoformalization task by distinguishing Ontology Extraction from Logical Translation, showing how their conflation obscures (cross-study) evaluation; we review existing datasets, evaluation metrics, and LLM-based methods, including fine-tuning, prompting, and verification-based refinement; we identify open challenges in benchmarking, semantic evaluation, ontology-aware methods, and end-to-end applications.
items.summary_zh: 系统梳理自然语言到一阶逻辑（FOL）自动形式化，区分本体抽取与逻辑翻译，并比较数据集、指标及验证式改进方法。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 明确拆分任务定义，有助于避免把语义建模和公式翻译混为一谈，并为可比评测提供基础。
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）重新激发了人们对自动形式化的兴趣。然而，当把一阶逻辑（FOL）作为目标形式体系时，该领域仍缺乏统一的任务表述和系统综述。本文弥补这一空白：首先，我们通过区分本体抽取与逻辑翻译，为 FOL 自动形式化任务给出原则性定义，并说明将二者混为一谈会如何掩盖跨研究评测中的问题；随后，我们综述现有数据集、评测指标和基于 LLM 的方法，包括微调、提示以及基于验证的改进；最后，我们指出基准测试、语义评估、面向本体的方法和端到端应用中的开放挑战。
items.author_line: Andrea Brunello, Cristian Curaba, Luca Geatti, Michele Mignani, Angelo Montanari, Nicola Saccomanno

items.title: LEVER: Adaptive Cost-Aware Proof Search Over AND/OR Graphs
items.abstract_or_text: Mathematicians value proofs for more than correctness: among correct proofs, simplicity, purity and the computational cost of finding them vary widely. Yet LLM-powered theorem provers largely search for any correct proof, and improve its quality only after it is found. We propose LEVER, a proof search algorithm that makes the objective over correct proofs programmable and optimizes it during search. LEVER scores partial proofs over an AND/OR proof graph, combining realized objective values with predictions for open subgoals, so the objective guides search before a proof is complete. The same mechanism optimizes computational cost, proof length, topical impurity, and even their weighted combinations, while the Lean kernel enforces correctness. On PutnamBench in Lean 4, under matched budgets, LEVER costs 34% less than a strong single-conversation agent while raising the solve rate from 80% to 96%. On reducing topical impurity, i.e., how far a proof strays from its theorem's subject, it improves over post-hoc refactoring (42% reduction against 33%) at two-thirds of the cost and more reliably; on proof length, the metric refactoring is built for, it approaches refactoring. Varying the objective's weights traces a quality-cost trade-off curve, so the user can choose how much a better proof is worth. Overall, LEVER is a performant, cost-efficient and tunable proof search algorithm for navigating the space of correct proofs.
items.summary_zh: LEVER 在 AND/OR 证明图上进行自适应、成本感知的 Lean 证明搜索，在 PutnamBench 上降低搜索成本并提高求解率，同时可优化证明长度和主题纯度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把“找到任意证明”扩展为搜索可编程目标的证明，为正确性之外的简洁性、成本和主题相关性提供可调权衡。
items.abstract_zh: 数学家重视证明并不仅仅因为其正确性：在正确证明之中，简洁性、纯粹性和寻找它们的计算成本也有很大差异。然而，基于 LLM 的定理证明器大多只搜索任意一个正确证明，并在找到证明后才改进其质量。我们提出 LEVER，这是一种证明搜索算法，使正确证明之间的目标可编程，并在搜索过程中优化该目标。LEVER 在 AND/OR 证明图上为部分证明评分，将已实现的目标值与开放子目标的预测结合起来，使目标在证明完成之前就能引导搜索。同一机制可以优化计算成本、证明长度、主题不纯度以及它们的加权组合，而 Lean 内核负责强制检查正确性。在 Lean 4 的 PutnamBench 上，在匹配预算下，LEVER 的成本比一个强大的单对话智能体低 34%，同时将求解率从 80% 提高到 96%。在降低主题不纯度方面——即证明偏离定理主题的程度——它比事后重构的改进更好（降低 42%，而事后重构为 33%），成本为其三分之二且更可靠；在证明长度方面，它接近为此指标设计的重构方法。改变目标权重可以描绘质量—成本权衡曲线，使用户能够选择更好证明的价值。总体而言，LEVER 是一种高性能、成本高效且可调的证明搜索算法，用于遍历正确证明空间。
items.author_line: Nihal Jain, Shuangjie Yao, Begum Cicekdag, Zhuo Zhang, Suman Jana

items.title: Neural Network Verification for Deep Joint Source-Channel Coding
items.abstract_or_text: Deep joint source-channel coding (DeepJSCC) transmits data end-to-end over wireless channels using a neural encoder-decoder, but reconstruction quality can degrade sharply under adversarial perturbations and channel disturbances; no method formally bounds this degradation for DeepJSCC. We present the first bound-propagation framework for verifying DeepJSCC's decoder, bounding worst-case reconstruction error over a given wireless channel's noise region. Current deep neural network (DNN) verifiers do not support three DeepJSCC decoder components: parametric rectified linear activations (PReLU), transposed convolutions, and Rayleigh fading. We extend state-of-the-art techniques for optimization of linear relaxation in DNN verification for PReLU, replace the transposed convolution with its restricted upsample-then-convolution form, and formulate Rayleigh fading as a structural perturbation prepended directly into the decoder, thereby reducing the dimensionality of the verification problem. We also instantiate Lipschitz-regularized global robustness training, denoted GloRo, improving global robustness and enabling tight certification of DeepJSCC models for the first time. On DeepJSCC model for image transmission, this global robustness training procedure combined with structural encoding lowers the median certified bound by up to 41% and certifies about ten times more safe cases (192 against 19) than GloRo with interval encoding at a 10-degree error in channel estimation. Over-the-air validation with an orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) implementation on software-defined radio devices confirm the certificate holds on real hardware, with a worst observed error on radio link at 0.082 against a certified bound of 0.128.
items.summary_zh: 提出适用于 DeepJSCC 解码器的界传播验证框架，覆盖 PReLU、转置卷积和 Rayleigh 衰落，并在真实无线硬件上验证认证界。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把神经网络验证从抽象模型推进到含信道扰动的通信系统，并报告可检验的最坏误差界与空口结果。
items.abstract_zh: 深度联合源信道编码（DeepJSCC）使用神经编码器—解码器通过无线信道端到端传输数据，但在对抗扰动和信道干扰下，重建质量可能急剧下降；目前没有方法对 DeepJSCC 的这种退化给出形式化界。我们提出第一个用于验证 DeepJSCC 解码器的界传播框架，对给定无线信道噪声区域内的最坏情况重建误差给出界。现有深度神经网络（DNN）验证器不支持 DeepJSCC 解码器的三个组件：参数化整流线性激活（PReLU）、转置卷积和 Rayleigh 衰落。我们扩展了用于优化 DNN 验证中线性松弛的现有技术以处理 PReLU；将转置卷积替换为受限的上采样后卷积形式；并将 Rayleigh 衰落表述为直接置于解码器前的结构扰动，从而降低验证问题的维度。我们还实例化了 Lipschitz 正则化的全局鲁棒性训练（记为 GloRo），提高全局鲁棒性，并首次实现对 DeepJSCC 模型的紧致认证。在用于图像传输的 DeepJSCC 模型上，这种全局鲁棒性训练与结构编码相结合，使认证界中位数最多降低 41%，并在信道估计误差为 10 度时认证约十倍数量的安全样例（192 个，相比 GloRo 配合区间编码的 19 个）。在正交频分复用（OFDM）软件定义无线电设备上的空口验证确认了该认证在真实硬件上成立：无线链路上观测到的最坏误差为 0.082，而认证界为 0.128。
items.author_line: Thanh Le, Hai Duong, Takeshi Matsumura, ThanhVu Nguyen

items.title: SynCo: Data Synthesis Co-Training for Self-Evolving LLMs via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Self-evolving LLM agents promise to improve autonomously through continual interaction and learning, reducing their dependence on manually curated supervision. Realizing this promise requires not only updating the agent, but also evolving its training experience as its capabilities change. However, most existing pipelines rely on static datasets or separately updated synthesis models, causing previously useful tasks to become trivial while overly difficult tasks remain uninformative. This growing mismatch between agent capability and training experience limits sustained self-improvement. To address this problem, we propose SynCo, an agentic data synthesis co-training framework for self-evolving LLMs based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. SynCo jointly optimizes two independently parameterized agents: a Synthesizer that constructs training tasks from the Reasoner's evolving capability state, and a Reasoner that learns from the resulting experience. Each synthesized task induces multiple Reasoner rollouts whose outcomes provide complementary rewards to both agents. Correctness feedback improves the Reasoner, while task quality, answer reliability, and outcome-grounded teachability guide the Synthesizer. Their updates are fed back into subsequent synthesis rounds, allowing the task-solving policy and its training distribution to evolve together. Extensive experiments across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that SynCo substantially outperforms a broad range of existing synthetic-data methods and controlled baselines, achieving the strongest overall performance while deriving most of its gains from previously unsolved problems.
items.summary_zh: SynCo 通过多智能体强化学习联合优化任务合成器与推理器，让数学训练数据随模型能力演化，并在八个数学推理基准上评测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对静态合成数据与模型能力错配问题，提供了任务难度自适应的训练机制和跨基准结果。
items.abstract_zh: 自我演化的 LLM 智能体有望通过持续交互和学习实现自主改进，减少对人工整理监督数据的依赖。实现这一愿景不仅需要更新智能体，还需要随着其能力变化而演化训练经验。然而，大多数现有流程依赖静态数据集或分别更新的合成模型，导致原本有用的任务变得过于简单，而过于困难的任务仍然无法提供信息。这种智能体能力与训练经验之间日益扩大的错配，限制了持续自我改进。为解决这一问题，我们提出 SynCo，一种基于多智能体强化学习的、面向自我演化 LLM 的智能体数据合成协同训练框架。SynCo 联合优化两个参数彼此独立的智能体：合成器根据推理器不断变化的能力状态构造训练任务，推理器从所得经验中学习。每个合成任务都会诱导推理器进行多次 rollout，其结果为两个智能体提供互补奖励。正确性反馈改进推理器，而任务质量、答案可靠性和以结果为依据的可教性则指导合成器。它们的更新被反馈到后续合成轮次，使解题策略及其训练分布共同演化。在八个数学推理基准上的大量实验表明，SynCo 显著优于多种现有合成数据方法和受控基线，取得最强的总体性能，并且其大部分增益来自此前未解决的问题。
items.author_line: Wei Yang, Shawn Li, Yuehan Qin, Yawei Wang, Mingxi Wang, Shixuan Li, Tiankai Yang, Jiate Li, Jesse Thomason, Xuezhe Ma, Yue Zhao

items.title: Learning Probabilistic Logic Programs with Functional Gradient Guided Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Declarative logic programs offer a powerful and interpretable abstraction for encoding relational structure and neurosymbolic reasoning, by expressing dependencies as weighted compositional rules. However, inducing them from data remains fundamentally hard, bottlenecked by the combinatorial explosion of symbolic search spaces. LLMs have recently emerged as powerful hypothesis generators, but when used in isolation, they lack the capacity to do systematic inductive reasoning needed to reliably synthesize valid programs that fit complex relational distributions. We introduce grasp (Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs), a neurosymbolic framework that casts relational structure learning as functional gradient boosting in which the weak learner is a first-order rule and the intractable inner search is delegated to an LLM proposal oracle. We evaluate grasp on four relational benchmarks spanning molecular toxicity prediction (Tox21), mutagenesis, and citation matching (Cora), and show that it improves over purely symbolic, neural, and LLM-based baselines, while producing interpretable weighted rule ensembles. By replacing combinatorial search with gradient-guided LLM hypothesis generation, grasp retains boosting guarantees without sacrificing the transparency of symbolic outputs.
items.summary_zh: GRASP 将关系结构学习表述为函数梯度提升，以 LLM 作为一阶规则提议器，在分子毒性、诱变和引文匹配基准上生成可解释的概率逻辑规则集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把 LLM 的候选生成与符号学习的梯度保证结合起来，兼顾关系推理的性能和可解释性。
items.abstract_zh: 声明式逻辑程序通过表达加权组合规则中的依赖关系，为编码关系结构和神经符号推理提供了强大且可解释的抽象。然而，从数据中归纳这些程序仍然非常困难，瓶颈在于符号搜索空间的组合爆炸。近年来，LLM 已成为强大的假设生成器，但单独使用时缺乏系统归纳推理能力，难以可靠地合成适合复杂关系分布的有效程序。我们提出 grasp（Gradient-boosted Synthesis of Probabilistic logic programs），一种神经符号框架：将关系结构学习表述为函数梯度提升，其中弱学习器是一阶规则，而难以处理的内部搜索则交给 LLM 提议预言机。在涵盖分子毒性预测（Tox21）、诱变和引文匹配（Cora）的四个关系基准上，我们评估 grasp，结果显示它优于纯符号、神经和基于 LLM 的基线，同时生成可解释的加权规则集。通过以梯度引导的 LLM 假设生成替代组合搜索，grasp 在不牺牲符号输出透明度的情况下保留了提升方法的保证。
items.author_line: Saurabh Mathur, Sahil Sidheekh, Bhavan Vasu, Farbod Tavakkoli, Prasad Tadepalli, Kristian Kersting, Sriraam Natarajan

items.title: GRASP: Graph Representation Learning with Assay Supervision for Molecular Properties
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular structures are abundant, while experimental bioactivity is sparse and distributed across assays. We introduce GRASP, a 93.5M-parameter graph Transformer that learns from these sources in sequence. GRASP first learns molecular structure through replaced-token detection on 1.54 billion ZINC20 molecule presentations, then adapts to sparse bioactivity across 642 ChEMBL assays. Across 23 cluster-held-out OpenADMET endpoints, GRASP achieves a mean MAE of 0.374, compared with 0.383 for CheMeleon, 0.408 for ECFP4-LightGBM, and 0.440 for Chemprop. ChEMBL adaptation reduces mean MAE from 0.407 to 0.374 and improves 21 of 23 endpoints, showing the value of intermediate bioactivity supervision. On 22 TDC ADMET tasks, GRASP gives a better point estimate than CheMeleon on 13 tasks. These results support staged molecular representation learning, where abundant molecular structure and sparse experimental measurements provide complementary supervision at different stages of training.
items.summary_zh: 提出 93.5M 参数的 GRASP 图 Transformer，先在 1.54 billion 次 ZINC20 分子呈现上学习结构，再用 642 个 ChEMBL assay 进行生物活性适配，在 OpenADMET 和 TDC ADMET 任务上与多种基线比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 展示了先利用大规模结构数据、再利用稀疏 assay supervision 的分阶段分子表示学习策略，对 ADMET 预测有直接意义。性能提升幅度总体有限，且摘要未提供不同 assay 质量和分布偏移下的误差分析。
items.abstract_zh: 分子结构数量丰富，而实验生物活性稀疏并分散在不同 assay 中。我们提出 GRASP，这是一种 93.5M 参数的图 Transformer，按顺序从这些来源学习。GRASP 首先在 1.54 billion 次 ZINC20 分子呈现上通过替换 token 检测学习分子结构，然后在 642 个 ChEMBL assay 上适应稀疏的生物活性数据。在 23 个按簇留出的 OpenADMET 终点上，GRASP 的平均 MAE 为 0.374，而 CheMeleon、ECFP4-LightGBM 和 Chemprop 分别为 0.383、0.408 和 0.440。ChEMBL 适配使平均 MAE 从 0.407 降至 0.374，并在 23 个终点中的 21 个上得到改善，说明中间的生物活性监督具有价值。在 22 个 TDC ADMET 任务上，GRASP 在 13 个任务中相较 CheMeleon 给出了更好的点估计。这些结果支持分阶段的分子表示学习：丰富的分子结构和稀疏的实验测量在训练的不同阶段提供互补监督。
items.author_line: Srivastava, S. P., Gorantla, R., Chundru, S. K., Singh, H., Mey, A. S. J. S., Singh, R. K.

items.title: μ-Oxo-Bridged Iodine(III) Reagents Enable Catalyst- and Light-Free Fluoro(halo)methyl Radical Generation
items.abstract_or_text: While conventional radical fluoroalkylation typically requires exogenous catalysts or photoactivation to overcome significant kinetic barriers, here we report bench-stable μ-oxo-bridged iodine(III) reagents that release fluoro(halo)methyl radicals upon heating without an external catalyst, additive, or light. The resulting radicals initiate cascade cyclizations of methacrylamides and methacrylohydrazides to afford fluorinated oxindoles, pyrazolones, and related heterocycles. Variation of the fluorinated carboxylate ligand within the iodine(III) reagent framework controls the identity of the transferred C1 fragment, thereby providing chlorofluoromethyl, bromofluoromethyl, difluoromethyl, and monofluoromethyl products from a common reagent architecture. The transformation is compatible with structurally diverse and natural-product-derived substrates and proceeds efficiently upon scale-up. By encoding the required bond lability directly into the iodine(III) framework, this strategy establishes a general platform for the catalyst-, additive-, and light-free generation and incorporation of fluorinated C1 radicals into complex molecular frameworks.
items.summary_zh: 报道稳定的 μ-Oxo-Bridged Iodine(III) 试剂，在无催化剂、添加剂或光照条件下加热释放 fluoro(halo)methyl radicals，并用于构建含氟 oxindoles、pyrazolones 等杂环。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将自由基生成所需的键活性编码进 iodine(III) 试剂，实现无外加催化体系的含氟 C1 片段引入，并报告多类底物和放大反应。作为 ChemRxiv v2 预印本，反应机理、底物范围边界和长期稳定性仍需独立验证。
items.abstract_zh: 传统自由基氟烷基化通常需要外加催化剂或光激活来克服显著的动力学障碍。我们在此报道了可在实验台稳定存在的 μ-oxo-bridged iodine(III) 试剂；这些试剂在加热时无需外部催化剂、添加剂或光照即可释放 fluoro(halo)methyl radicals。所得自由基引发 methacrylamides 和 methacrylohydrazides 的级联环化，生成 fluorinated oxindoles、pyrazolones 和相关杂环。改变 iodine(III) 试剂骨架中的含氟羧酸配体，可以控制转移的 C1 片段种类，因此同一试剂架构能够提供 chlorofluoromethyl、bromofluoromethyl、difluoromethyl 和 monofluoromethyl 产物。该转化兼容结构多样的底物和天然产物衍生底物，并可有效放大。通过将所需的键易裂解性直接编码进 iodine(III) 骨架，这一策略建立了一个通用平台，可在复杂分子骨架中生成并引入含氟 C1 自由基。
items.author_line: Anupam Das, Nagarajan Ramkumar, Artis Kinēns, Sergey Belyakov, Andris Antuzevičs, Janis Veliks

items.title: Forecasting Alzheimer's disease progression using non-imaging clinical features and XGBoost
items.abstract_or_text: Identifying progressive dementia during its prodromal stage is a challenging yet critical task for healthcare providers. Traditional clinical assessments are often not sensitive enough to detect warning signs of cognitive decline. Machine learning (ML) methods have shown promise in modeling clinical trajectories associated with neurodegenerative disorders such as Alzheimers disease (AD). Validation of these models forecasting abilities, however, is widely lacking in the literature. To address this gap, we established a longitudinal cohort from the National Alzheimers Coordinating Center (n = 15,727) comprising individuals who were cognitively normal (CN) or had mild cognitive impairment (MCI) at baseline. Cognitive status and clinical observations collected over up to 10 visits were used to train several ML classifiers. We employed the gradient-boosted tree ensemble method XGBoost with a custom feature-engineering pipeline. On non-imputed data, our models achieved an AUC-ROC of 0.9447 [0.9417-0.9476] and PR-AUC of 0.8554 [0.8497-0.8611] for the CN[->]MCI task, and an AUC-ROC of 0.9059 [0.8983-0.9134] and PR-AUC of 0.9214 [0.9156-0.9272] for the MCI[->]AD task. In a lead-time forecasting analysis spanning mean follow-up periods of 56.1 months (range, 9.1-214.1) for CN[->]MCI and 42.7 months (range, 9.1-126.1) for MCI[->]AD, the non-imputed models detected future progression before diagnosis in 29.58% [28.29%-30.87%] of CN[->]MCI progressors and 22.41% [21.36%-23.46%] of MCI[->]AD progressors. Among these individuals, the mean lead time was 33.04 months [32.52-33.56] and 17.95 months [17.71-18.19], respectively. False alarm rates among non-progressors were 12.6% [11.5%-13.7%] and 20.0% [18.4%-21.6%], respectively. These findings suggest that longitudinal machine learning models can identify future cognitive decline before diagnosis, indicating clinical utility for early dementia risk stratification. Author summaryAlzheimers disease (AD) is a progressive and currently incurable neurodegenerative disorder that remains highly difficult to diagnose during its early stages. While modern early-stage dementia research relies on advanced neuroimaging, the high cost of these tests excludes many vulnerable communities. We designed our study to advance scalable, low-cost diagnostic alternatives that can identify individuals at significant risk of cognitive decline, ensuring faster access to emerging therapies. We examined trajectories of cognitive decline in 15,727 adults (mean age = 71.45 years, SD = 9.06) who had between 2 and 10 follow-up visits. Using 37 demographic, behavioral, clinical, and genetic variables, we modeled cognitively stable and declining trajectories using the XGBoost algorithm. Additionally, we evaluated the models ability to forecast future diagnoses and the impact of longitudinal imputation. Our models performed well in both classification tasks (AUC-ROC [≥] 0.90). Imputation did not substantively alter the classifiers performance. In forecasting diagnosis conversion, the models raised alarms before the recorded conversion visit in a subset of progressors, with non-imputed models yielding longer net lead times than imputed models in AD forecasting. This work describes a strategy for handling mixed-length temporal dimensions in longitudinal cohorts and evaluates its prognostic ability.
items.summary_zh: 预印本在 NACC 纵向队列15,727人上用 XGBoost 和37项非影像特征预测 CN→MCI 与 MCI→AD 转化，并报告最长约214个月随访中的提前预警比例。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 其规模和纵向设计支持低成本风险分层研究，但仅在单一队列的回顾性数据上建模；提前报警并不等于延缓疾病或改善临床结局。
items.abstract_zh: 在前驱期识别进行性痴呆对医疗服务提供者而言困难但至关重要。传统临床评估通常不足以敏感地发现认知衰退的预警信号。机器学习（ML）方法已显示出建模阿尔茨海默病（AD）等神经退行性疾病临床轨迹的潜力。然而，文献中对这些模型预测能力的验证仍普遍不足。为弥补这一缺口，我们建立了一个来自 National Alzheimer’s Coordinating Center 的纵向队列（n = 15,727），纳入基线认知正常（CN）或轻度认知障碍（MCI）的个体。我们使用最多10次访视收集的认知状态和临床观察结果，训练多个 ML 分类器。我们采用带有自定义特征工程流程的梯度提升树集成方法 XGBoost。在未插补数据上，模型对 CN[→]MCI 任务达到 AUC-ROC 0.9447 [0.9417—0.9476] 和 PR-AUC 0.8554 [0.8497—0.8611]；对 MCI[→]AD 任务达到 AUC-ROC 0.9059 [0.8983—0.9134] 和 PR-AUC 0.9214 [0.9156—0.9272]。在提前量预测分析中，CN[→]MCI 的平均随访期为56.1个月（范围9.1—214.1），MCI[→]AD 为42.7个月（范围9.1—126.1）；未插补模型分别在29.58% [28.29%—30.87%] 的 CN[→]MCI 进展者和22.41% [21.36%—23.46%] 的 MCI[→]AD 进展者被正式诊断前检测到未来进展。在这些个体中，平均提前量分别为33.04个月 [32.52—33.56] 和17.95个月 [17.71—18.19]。非进展者的假警报率分别为12.6% [11.5%—13.7%] 和20.0% [18.4%—21.6%]。这些结果提示，纵向机器学习模型可以在诊断前识别未来认知衰退，说明其可能用于早期痴呆风险分层。作者总结：AD 是一种进行性且目前无法治愈的神经退行性疾病，在早期阶段仍很难诊断。现代早期痴呆研究依赖先进神经影像，但这些检查成本高昂，排除了许多脆弱人群。我们旨在推进可扩展、低成本的诊断替代方案，以识别认知衰退风险显著的人群，从而更快获得新兴疗法。我们研究了15,727名成人的认知衰退轨迹（平均年龄71.45岁，SD = 9.06），这些人接受了2—10次随访。我们使用37项人口学、行为、临床和遗传变量，利用 XGBoost 对认知稳定和衰退轨迹建模。此外，我们评估了模型对未来诊断转化的预测能力以及纵向插补的影响。两个分类任务的模型表现均良好（AUC-ROC [≥] 0.90）。在预测诊断转化时，模型在部分进展者的记录转化访视之前发出警报；在 AD 预测中，未插补模型比插补模型产生更长的净提前量。该研究描述了一种处理纵向队列中不同长度时间维度的策略，并评估了其预后能力。

items.title: Beyond Type-checking: Towards Holistic Evaluation of Formal Specification Generation
items.abstract_or_text: When generating verifiable code, natural language requirements are mapped to machine checked code using LLMs and agentic workflows. A crucial component of this pipeline is specification generation (SpecGen), which produces a formal contract against which an agent can prove implementation correctness. Proof generation can obtain deterministic feedback from a theorem prover, but SpecGen lacks a definitive check that a generated specification captures the user's intent. A checked proof can therefore establish correctness against a specification that misrepresents the intended behaviour. We take a step towards holistic SpecGen evaluation with a unified dataset assembled from 350 existing Lean tasks, including 189 from VERINA and 161 from CLEVER, and a framework covering formal validity, reference similarity and equivalence, and behavioural adequacy. We distinguish acceptance of required inputs from acceptance of valid outputs and rejection of invalid outputs, while making each metric's evidence scope explicit. Across four SpecGen configurations, restricting the generalized tree edit distance (GTED) comparison, a reference similarity measure, to 32 jointly measurable VERINA tasks changes the VERINA configuration's position from second to fourth in mean similarity, showing the importance of measurement coverage. In an authored control, a specification achieves 100\% positive test recall and negative test rejection while accepting 0\% of required inputs. This demonstrates that perfect postcondition scores can miss an unusable input contract, motivating separate feedback on input coverage and output constraints.
items.summary_zh: 提出覆盖形式有效性、参考相似度/等价性和行为充分性的 Lean 形式规格生成评测框架，揭示仅检查证明并不能保证规格符合用户意图。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把输入覆盖与输出约束分开评估，说明“证明通过”可能掩盖不可用或误表意的形式规格。
items.abstract_zh: 在生成可验证代码时，自然语言需求会借助 LLM 和智能体工作流映射为机器检查的代码。该流程的一个关键组件是规格生成（SpecGen），它产生形式化契约，智能体据此证明实现的正确性。证明生成可以从定理证明器获得确定性反馈，但 SpecGen 缺少一个明确检查来确认生成的规格是否捕捉了用户意图。因此，经检查的证明可能只是确立了相对于错误表述的规格的正确性。我们朝着全面评估 SpecGen 迈出一步：构建一个由 350 个现有 Lean 任务组成的统一数据集，其中包括来自 VERINA 的 189 个任务和来自 CLEVER 的 161 个任务；并提出覆盖形式有效性、参考相似度与等价性以及行为充分性的框架。我们区分对必需输入的接受、对有效输出的接受以及对无效输出的拒绝，同时明确每项指标的证据范围。在四种 SpecGen 配置中，将广义树编辑距离（GTED）这一参考相似度指标限制在 32 个可共同测量的 VERINA 任务上，会使 VERINA 配置在平均相似度中的排名由第二降至第四，显示出测量覆盖范围的重要性。在一个人工编写的对照中，一份规格对正例测试达到 100% 的召回率并拒绝负例测试，却接受了 0% 的必需输入。这表明，完美的后置条件得分可能遗漏不可用的输入契约，因此有必要分别反馈输入覆盖和输出约束。
items.author_line: Srijith Nair, Aditya Vempaty, Jia Liu, Ashish Jagmohan

items.title: The Long Road to the Same Answer: Cognitive Bias Under Escalating Reasoning Budgets in Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Reasoning models allocate extra computation at inference time and present their answers as the product of deliberate thought. If this deliberation works the way dual-process accounts of human cognition suggest, longer thinking should weaken the classic decision biases that fast, intuitive judgment produces. Using 30 vignettes covering six biases (anchoring, framing, loss aversion, escalation of commitment, availability, confirmation) from an established benchmark, we run a dose-response study across four model families, pairing each reasoning model with a matched non-reasoning sibling and requesting thinking ceilings of 0, 1,024, 4,096, and 8,192 tokens, for 12,350 API calls. Because a requested ceiling is not the same as realized deliberation, we use the reasoning tokens each call consumed as the dose. First, reasoning models are not less biased than their siblings; the point estimate leans the other way in every family, but the item-level pooled contrast is not reliable (Delta = +0.031, t(29) = 1.45, p = .157). Second, bias magnitude does not reliably fall as realized deliberation grows: no slope is significantly negative, and where anything moves it is the signed score drifting further from the human direction. Third, anchoring is the only bias in the human direction (d = 1.89). Four of the other five lean the opposite way in all seven models; with five items per bias, that reversal is reliable for framing and directional for escalation of commitment, confirmation, and loss aversion, while availability is absent. A one-line instruction to restate the anchor before answering lowered anchoring on all five anchoring items, which no amount of additional thinking did, although the effect does not reach significance (p = .057). The results argue against treating test-time reasoning as a rationality guarantee and for auditing deployed models bias by bias.
items.summary_zh: 在四类模型、六种认知偏差和 12,350 次调用上研究推理预算与偏差的关系，结果显示增加思考长度并不可靠地降低偏差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为“更多测试时思考就更理性”的说法提供了反例式评测，并强调应按偏差类型逐项审计。
items.abstract_zh: 推理模型在推理时分配额外计算，并将答案呈现为审慎思考的产物。如果这种审议过程像人类认知的双过程理论所描述的那样运作，那么更长的思考应当削弱快速、直觉判断产生的经典决策偏差。我们使用一个已建立基准中的 30 个情境，覆盖六种偏差（锚定、框架、损失厌恶、承诺升级、可得性和确认），在四个模型家族上开展剂量—反应研究；每个推理模型都与一个匹配的非推理同胞模型配对，并要求思考上限为 0、1,024、4,096 和 8,192 个 token，共进行 12,350 次 API 调用。由于请求的上限并不等于实际发生的思考，我们使用每次调用消耗的推理 token 作为剂量。首先，推理模型并不比其同胞模型更少偏差；每个家族的点估计都朝相反方向偏移，但项目层面的汇总差异并不可靠（Delta = +0.031，t(29) = 1.45，p = .157）。其次，随着实际推理增加，偏差幅度并不会可靠下降：没有一条斜率显著为负；在发生变化的地方，带符号得分反而进一步偏离人类方向。第三，锚定是唯一朝人类方向的偏差（d = 1.89）。其他五种偏差中的四种在全部七个模型上都朝相反方向；每种偏差只有五个题目时，这种反转对框架偏差是可靠的，对承诺升级、确认和损失厌恶则呈方向性，而可得性偏差不存在。一条要求回答前重述锚点的指令降低了五个锚定题上的锚定程度，而增加思考没有做到这一点，但该效应未达到显著性（p = .057）。结果反对把测试时推理视为理性保证，并支持按偏差类型对已部署模型进行审计。

items.abstract_or_text: We're excited to invest in Preference Model. Building RL environments that actually work is harder than it looks. Models are relentless at reward hacking, finding shortcuts, and exploiting vulnerabilities. @preferencemodel has focused on the domain that matters most to labs right now: AI research and ML engineering itself. items.abstract_or_text: Scientists have sequenced the genomes of thousands of species. But for most of them, nobody knows *where the genes are* Today we're releasing Carbon-A, an open model that finds genes directly in DNA. We used it to create a database of 566 million candidate genes across 22,617 species, from fungi to mammals (that we are sharing as well) Carbon-A belongs to a newer family of tools that read DNA directly. It learned from known genomes, but it doesn't need a close relative to read a new one. With our partners at Active Site and UCSD, we found RNA evidence for 239 genes missing from the reference annotations of species as common as cats, chickens, hamsters and a lab plant. AlphaFold can predict the shape of a protein, but only once someone has found the gene that makes it. In a species with no annotated genes, it has nothing to work with. items.title: Frustration Quenching and Network Topology of the Energy Landscape as Primary Determinants of Protein-Ligand Binding Pose Prediction by Deep Learning Models
items.abstract_or_text: Deep learning co-folding and docking models accurately predict ligand binding poses at orthosteric sites yet systematically underperform at allosteric pockets. Here, we demonstrate that this accuracy gap reflects a fundamental biophysical property of local energy landscape topology specifically, the magnitude of frustration quenching upon ligand binding rather than an intrinsic algorithmic defect. By evaluating leading co-folding and docking paradigms across curated benchmarks and large-scale uncurated datasets, we show that AI prediction success strongly tracks frustration quenching which the degree to which ligand binding relieves local energetic strain to form a steep energy funnel. Topologically, frustration-weighted residue interaction networks reveal that orthosteric pockets act as high-betweenness communication hubs embedded within contiguous, minimally frustrated pathways. In contrast, allosteric sites reside in low-betweenness peripheral regions with fragmented frustration profiles, presenting flatter, entropy-dominated landscapes that challenge structure prediction algorithms. Comparing generative diffusion with single-shot regression demonstrates that multi-pose sampling capacity is required to cross energy barriers and discover the frustration funnel, whereas joint receptor-ligand coordinate co-adaptation governs local optimization within the funnel. Collectively, this study reframes the allosteric "blind spot" as a quantitative property of energy landscape architecture rather than a defect of any specific predictive framework. We demonstrate that frustration quenching magnitude and structural network centrality serve as physical descriptors that define the intrinsic limits of AI performance, reframing AI accuracy from a benchmark metric into a physics-grounded quantitative reporter of macromolecular binding landscape architecture.

items.why_it_matters_zh: 将模型在变构位点上的盲区与可量化的能量景观拓扑联系起来，有助于把基准性能解释为物理性质而非单纯算法指标。摘要显示其依赖基准和大规模数据集，且结论主要来自计算分析，仍需更多实验结构和跨体系验证。
items.abstract_zh: 深度学习共折叠和对接模型能够准确预测正构位点的配体结合姿态，但在变构口袋上的表现系统性较差。我们证明，这一准确率差距反映的是局部能量景观拓扑的基本生物物理性质，具体而言是配体结合时 frustration quenching 的幅度，而不是算法本身的缺陷。通过在整理后的基准和大规模未整理数据集上评估领先的共折叠与对接范式，我们表明，AI 预测成功率与 frustration quenching 密切相关；frustration quenching 表示配体结合缓解局部能量应变并形成陡峭能量漏斗的程度。从拓扑上看，加权 frustration 的残基相互作用网络显示，正构口袋是高 betweenness 的通信枢纽，嵌入连续且最小 frustration 的通路中。相比之下，变构位点位于低 betweenness 的外围区域，具有碎片化的 frustration 分布，呈现更平坦、由熵主导的景观，从而给结构预测算法带来挑战。对生成式 diffusion 与单次回归的比较表明，跨越能垒并发现 frustration 漏斗需要多姿态采样能力，而受体-配体坐标的联合协同适应则负责漏斗内的局部优化。总体而言，本研究将变构“盲区”重新解释为能量景观架构的定量性质，而不是任何特定预测框架的缺陷。我们证明，frustration quenching 幅度和结构网络中心性可作为描述内在 AI 性能极限的物理指标，把 AI 准确率重新定义为大分子结合景观架构的、以物理学为基础的定量报告指标。

items.title: Machine Learning of Methacrylated Dextran Phase Separation for Prediction, Transferability, and Adaptation
items.abstract_or_text: Thermoresponsive polymers are promising materials for separations, sensing, drug delivery, and other biomedical applications, but their phase behavior depends on numerous polymer and solution variables, which creates a formulation space that is impractical to explore exhaustively by experiments. Here, we develop machine-learning (ML) models for predicting the lower critical solution temperature (LCST) of methacrylated dextran (Dex-MA), a biocompatible polysaccharide-based polymer, using 403 unique experimentally measured formulations spanning polymer molecular weight, degree of methacrylation, concentration, salts, surfactants, and other additives. The dataset is nonuniformly sampled because of practical synthesis constraints and application priorities. Despite this nonuniformity, descriptor-and molecular-embedding-based XGBoost and multilayer perceptron (MLP) models achieved mean absolute errors of 3.6 o C to 3.7 o C and 5.4 o C to 5.7 o C, respectively, for within-domain LCST prediction and mean phase-behavior classification accuracies of 89.4–89.6% and 85.3–86.6%, respectively. However, strong within-domain performance did not uniformly transfer to unseen formulation domains. Systematically withholding entire polymer, surfactant, and salt domains produced domain-dependent losses in predictive accuracy; for example, withholding 86 and 250 kDa Dex-MA increased LCST prediction errors to 11.4 o C and 17.5 o C, respectively, whereas errors for held-out surfactants were 5.6–7.2 o C. Progressive incorporation of target-domain measurements recovered predictive accuracy, but the recovery rate varied substantially with additive and salt identity and polymer molecular weight. This work provides a framework not only for predicting thermoresponsive-polymer phase behavior but also for evaluating model transferability to new formulation domains and guiding experimental data collection for model adaptation.

items.title: De novo protein design in an expanded chemical space
items.abstract_or_text: Generative protein design has made sequence and structure programmable, yet its chemical alphabet remains largely confined to the canonical twenty. Here, we establish CheMoDesign, an experimentally validated generative framework for designing proteins de novo around user-specified chemistry. CheMoDesign weakens pair-representation conditioning in a pretrained all-atom structure-prediction model while preserving chemical anchors, then refines generated backbones through sequence-conditioned denoising. By treating post-translational modifications, synthetic residues, and chemical modifications as user-defined building blocks, the framework generated proteins with chemistry-dependent recognition and reactivity in single-round experimental campaigns. Sulfotyrosine and nitrotyrosine enabled modification-dependent recognition of thrombin and HER2, respectively. Genetically encoded noncanonical residues enabled bioorthogonal affinity switching and light- or proximity-triggered covalent target capture. Post-expression chemical modifications yielded a light-activated covalent PD-L1 binder and an isoform-selective CA IX inhibitor (KD = 45 nM) designed to engage catalytic Zn2+;. CheMoDesign makes chemical mechanism a programmable dimension of de novo protein design.

items.abstract_zh: 生成式蛋白设计已经使序列和结构变得可编程，但其化学字母表仍主要局限于 canonical twenty。在这里，我们建立了 CheMoDesign，这是一个经过实验验证的生成式框架，用于围绕用户指定的化学性质从头设计蛋白质。CheMoDesign 在预训练的 all-atom 结构预测模型中弱化 pair-representation conditioning，同时保留化学锚点，然后通过 sequence-conditioned denoising 对生成的骨架进行细化。通过将翻译后修饰、合成残基和化学修饰视为用户定义的构件，该框架在单轮实验中生成了具有化学依赖性识别和反应性的蛋白质。Sulfotyrosine 和 nitrotyrosine 分别实现了对 thrombin 和 HER2 的修饰依赖性识别。遗传编码的非 canonical 残基实现了 bioorthogonal affinity switching，以及光触发或邻近触发的共价靶标捕获。表达后化学修饰产生了一个光激活共价 PD-L1 binder 和一个 isoform-selective CA IX inhibitor（KD = 45 nM），后者被设计为结合催化性 Zn2+。CheMoDesign 使化学机制成为 de novo 蛋白设计中的可编程维度。

items.title: DECONVersation: Single Cell Foundation Model-Derived Embeddings for Robust Cell Type Deconvolution of Bulk RNA-seq
items.abstract_or_text: AI and deep learning have transformed single-cell transcriptomics, empowering unsupervised annotation, trajectory inference, and cross-dataset integration at scale. Here, we propose bulk RNA-seq deconvolution as a novel task for single-cell foundation models. Deconvolution estimates cell type proportions from bulk RNA-seq using single-cell reference data, with applications spanning tumor microenvironment profiling to the detection of disease-associated shifts in tissue composition. However, existing methods remain vulnerable to batch effects, subject-level variation, and marker gene selection sensitivity. We introduce DECONVersation, which leverages embeddings from pretrained and fine-tuned single-cell foundation models, coupled with a non-negative least squares solver, to estimate cell type proportions. Foundation model embeddings are robust to batch effects and implicitly encode complex gene relationships, sidestepping explicit marker gene selection. Benchmarked against MuSiC, DWLS, and BayesPrism, DECONVersation achieved comparable or superior performance across diverse tissues. Performance further improved with tissue-specific fine-tuning.
items.summary_zh: 预印本提出 DECONVersation，用单细胞基础模型嵌入结合非负最小二乘法，从 bulk RNA-seq 估计细胞类型比例，并在多组织数据上与 MuSiC、DWLS 和 BayesPrism 比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把单细胞基础模型用于 bulk RNA-seq 去卷积，尝试降低批次效应和标记基因选择敏感性；但摘要未给出具体数据规模和效应量，结论主要限于基准比较。
items.abstract_zh: AI 和深度学习已经改变了单细胞转录组学，使无监督注释、轨迹推断和跨数据集整合能够在大规模上进行。在这里，我们提出将 bulk RNA-seq 去卷积作为单细胞基础模型的一项新任务。去卷积利用单细胞参考数据，从 bulk RNA-seq 估计细胞类型比例，可应用于肿瘤微环境分析以及检测组织组成中与疾病相关的变化。然而，现有方法仍容易受到批次效应、个体层面变异和标记基因选择敏感性的影响。我们提出 DECONVersation，利用预训练和微调的单细胞基础模型嵌入，并结合非负最小二乘求解器来估计细胞类型比例。基础模型嵌入对批次效应具有鲁棒性，并隐式编码复杂的基因关系，从而避免显式选择标记基因。与 MuSiC、DWLS 和 BayesPrism 的基准比较显示，DECONVersation 在多种组织中取得了相当或更好的性能。组织特异性微调进一步改善了性能。

items.title: A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools. However, existing agentic BBO studies use different task domains and system configurations, making their results difficult to compare and the effects of individual design choices hard to isolate. We therefore introduce AgenticBBO-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark for agentic BBO spanning synthetic functions, hyperparameter optimization, database tuning, chip design, and molecular design under a unified finite-budget evaluation protocol. In our experiments, agentic BBO achieves higher family-averaged scores than direct LLM-based methods in all five domains and outperforms the best numerical optimizers in four. We further study three factors shaping agent performance: optimization tools, task information and prior knowledge, and the role of the LLM during search. Our results show that additional numerical tools do not consistently improve performance, task semantics are broadly useful while more specific priors are less reliable, and numerical optimizers can effectively absorb gains from search trajectories established by the agent. Finally, we introduce a five-task frontier challenge within AgenticBBO-Bench and evaluate seven LLMs under the Codex agent harness, where GPT-6 Astra and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash lie on the Pareto frontier of performance and cost among the evaluated models. Our code is available at https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo.
items.summary_zh: 建立 AgenticBBO-Bench，在统一有限预算协议下跨合成函数、超参数优化、数据库调优、芯片设计和分子设计评估 LLM 代理黑盒优化，并分析工具、任务语义和先验知识的作用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供跨领域、可比较的 agentic BBO 基准，其中包含分子设计任务，并区分了工具调用、任务语义和数值优化器的贡献。结论依赖特定代理配置和有限预算，不能直接等同于真实化学实验闭环效率。
items.abstract_zh: 黑盒优化（BBO）出现在许多目标评估昂贵且数量有限的科学与工程问题中。近期大型语言模型（LLM）代理通过结合任务语义、计算、优化工具和基于反馈的决策，为 BBO 提供了新路径；由于能够与数学上严格的工具集成，这类方法显示出很大潜力。然而，现有 agentic BBO 研究使用不同的任务领域和系统配置，导致结果难以比较，也难以隔离单个设计选择的影响。因此，我们提出 AgenticBBO-Bench，这是一个跨领域的 agentic BBO 基准，在统一的有限预算评估协议下涵盖合成函数、超参数优化、数据库调优、芯片设计和分子设计。在实验中，agentic BBO 在全部五个领域取得了高于直接基于 LLM 方法的领域平均分，并在其中四个领域超过了最佳数值优化器。我们进一步研究影响代理性能的三个因素：优化工具、任务信息与先验知识，以及 LLM 在搜索中的作用。结果表明，额外的数值工具并不总能改善性能，任务语义普遍有用，而更具体的先验知识可靠性较低；数值优化器能够有效吸收代理建立的搜索轨迹所带来的收益。最后，我们在 AgenticBBO-Bench 中提出一个五任务前沿挑战，并在 Codex agent harness 下评估七个 LLM；在所评估模型中，GPT-6 Astra 和 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 位于性能与成本的 Pareto 前沿。代码可在 https://github.com/lamda-bbo/agentic-bbo 获取。

items.title: MAST: Motif-Augmented Diffusion with Search Tree for Spectroscopic Molecular Structure Elucidation
items.abstract_or_text: Elucidating molecular structures from spectra is a foundational problem in chemical and materials characterization, yet remains challenging due to spectral ambiguity and the vast molecular space. Although recent diffusion-based generators show strong promise for spectra-conditioned elucidation, existing methods struggle to learn robust spectra-structure relationships from limited paired data when relying solely on global spectral representation. Moreover, the repeated full sampling inference strategy incurs substantial computation overhead. To address these limitations, we propose MAST, a Motif-Augmented diffusion framework with Search Tree, for joint 2D-3D spectroscopic molecular structure elucidation. MAST introduces explicit, interpretable motif priors as intermediate evidences throughout denoising, reducing conditional ambiguity and facilitating spectra-conditioned optimization. We further cast diffusion sampling as reward-guided tree search to prioritize high-reward denoising trajectories, yielding a compact set of spectra-consistent candidates under limited budgets. On the QM9S multi-spectra benchmark, MAST achieves 94.89\% exact recovery and improves 3D fidelity, while preserving high chemical validity and stability. Code is available at https://github.com/Jia040223/MAST.
items.summary_zh: 提出 MAST，将可解释的 motif 先验注入 diffusion 去噪过程，并以奖励引导的搜索树减少光谱到分子结构解析中的采样开销，在 QM9S 多光谱基准上报告 94.89% exact recovery。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对光谱歧义和扩散模型重复采样成本，引入中间结构证据与搜索策略，兼顾二维和三维结构解析。结果基于 QM9S 基准，真实实验光谱和更大化学空间中的泛化仍需验证。
items.abstract_zh: 从光谱解析分子结构是化学和材料表征中的基础问题，但光谱歧义和巨大的分子空间使其仍然困难。尽管近期基于 diffusion 的生成模型在光谱条件结构解析方面显示出很大潜力，但现有方法仅依赖全局光谱表示，在配对数据有限时难以学习稳健的光谱-结构关系。此外，反复进行完整采样推理会带来很高的计算开销。为解决这些局限，我们提出 MAST，即用于联合二维-三维光谱分子结构解析的 Motif-Augmented diffusion with Search Tree 框架。MAST 在去噪过程中引入显式且可解释的 motif 先验作为中间证据，以减少条件歧义并促进光谱条件优化。我们进一步将 diffusion 采样表述为奖励引导的树搜索，以优先选择高奖励的去噪轨迹，在有限预算下得到一组紧凑且与光谱一致的候选结构。在 QM9S 多光谱基准上，MAST 达到 94.89% 的 exact recovery，并改善三维保真度，同时保持较高的化学有效性和稳定性。代码可在 https://github.com/Jia040223/MAST 获取。
items.author_line: Chenghao Jia, Mengdi Liu, Hong Chang, Shiguang Shan, Xilin Chen

items.title: Active synthesizability prediction for a virtual space of 395 million catalyst candidates with small data
items.abstract_or_text: N-heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs) are well established as catalysts and ligands in many chemical transformations. Recently, interest has grown in pyridine[1,5]imidazolium salt pre-catalysts, stable precursors to NHCs, because they are relatively easy to synthesize and highly adaptable. This work introduces a data-driven workflow to identify which pyridine[1,5]imidazolium salts are readily synthetically accessible, starting from exploratory synthesis attempts for 127 compounds. Our approach relies on a feedback loop with a supervised machine learning model to estimate and dynamically update the synthesizability for a combinatorial space of about 394 million pre-catalysts derived from commercially available precursors. Our final model estimates that 4.78% of the entire space are feasible, mapping the space of readily accessible candidates and providing a valuable set for future inverse design studies. We validated the prediction performance of our approach based on both literature data and a holdout set occupying extremes of the combinatorial space.
items.summary_zh: 用127个探索性合成尝试构建反馈式监督学习流程，预测约394 million 个 pyridine[1,5]imidazolium salt pre-catalyst 的可合成性，并用文献数据和组合空间极端区域留出集验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将可合成性作为虚拟催化剂空间筛选的显式约束，显著缩小后续逆向设计的可行搜索空间。预测空间规模很大但初始实验样本仅127个，模型在更广泛结构域上的校准和真实合成成功率仍需关注。
items.abstract_zh: N-heterocyclic carbenes（NHCs）已成为许多化学转化中成熟的催化剂和配体。近期，人们对 pyridine[1,5]imidazolium salt pre-catalysts 的兴趣不断增加，因为它们是稳定的 NHC 前体，相对容易合成且高度可调。本文提出一个数据驱动流程，用于识别哪些 pyridine[1,5]imidazolium salts 容易合成；该流程从 127 个化合物的探索性合成尝试开始。我们的方法依赖监督机器学习模型的反馈循环，以估计并动态更新由商业可得前体构建的约 394 million 个 pre-catalysts 组合空间中的可合成性。最终模型估计整个空间中有 4.78% 是可行的，并绘制了易于获得的候选物空间，为未来的逆向设计研究提供了有价值的集合。我们使用文献数据以及占据组合空间极端区域的留出集验证了预测性能。
